config.relevance: exact canonical evidence unit within the selected version
config.visual: flagged by label; record explicit refusal; exclude from retrieval metrics
config.generator: signed-in Codex CLI, one attempt per question

config.cache: fresh application and artifact store; OS file cache uncontrolled

config.answer_scoring: inspect emitted answers and each citation against gold and source text
